title: Email 2FA Bypass When Switching Users
summary:
### Impact

A session handling bug allowed any authenticated staff user to log in as any other staff user with the password only, bypassing 2FA.

### Vulnerable versions

This vulnerability is present in Ghost from v6.20.0 up to v6.57.1.

### Patches

v6.57.1 contains a fix for this issue.

### How to update

For self-hosters using Docker, find [Docker's official Ghost image here](https://hub.docker.com/_/ghost). Updating a Docker-based Ghost instance [is documented here](https://docs.ghost.org/install/docker#updating-ghost). 

If your Ghost is a Ghost-CLI install see our documentation on [updating it to the latest version here](https://docs.ghost.org/update). 

### References

We thank [Jaeyoon Kim](https://github.com/jaeyoon-kim-dev) and [doanmanhducz](https://github.com/doanmanhducz) for disclosing this vulnerability responsibly.

### For more information

If you have any questions or comments about this advisory, email us at [security@ghost.org](mailto:security@ghost.org).
